what: Hovering a product photo brings it into focus while a veil covers the area behind it, blurring it 10px (.2s), and an underlined label (”Feel it”) rises in the center in .3s ease. On release it clears over the same length and the label disappears — a product cell that lets you imagine the touch

options.--fx-label-dur: Duration of label showing and hiding (css variable), default .3s
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Veil over the photo (child, covers the whole photo frame)

use: Your hover text here

from.where: index.html · list.html .x-card__img product slot (original .gallery_hover-filter — CSS transition all .2s + IX2 a-23/a-24 label .3s ease)

note: On touch devices (no hover) the veil is not applied — the original also appears only on hover
